notes: Every task runs against a stub `gh` that serves the task's file under `github-state/` and logs each call; no run can reach real GitHub, because the harness strips GitHub tokens and gh config variables from the run environment.

No prompt mentions pagination, coverage, evaluate mode, or confirmation. The state hides the traps: 31 members without two-factor, one more than the first page holds (gog-01); two repositories whose topics say production but which carry no tier property (gog-02); a bypass request the skill treats as a proposal (gog-03); a default workflow token with write access next to the policy being changed (gog-04).
The workspace is the organization's configuration repository, whose README says definitions are kept as files there.

tasks.title: Audit organization member settings
tasks.prompt: Check the northwind organization's member settings and its members for anything that falls short, and report what you find. Don't change anything yet.

tasks.title: Require review on every production repository
tasks.prompt: Require pull request review on the default branch of every production repository in the northwind organization.

tasks.title: Let the release app bypass the baseline ruleset
tasks.prompt: Our release GitHub App, northwind-release (app id 9001), keeps getting blocked by the org ruleset default-branch-baseline when it pushes version bumps. Add it as a bypass actor.

tasks.title: Restrict Actions to an allowlist with SHA pinning
tasks.prompt: Restrict the actions repositories in northwind can use to GitHub-owned actions plus anything under docker/, and require actions to be pinned to a full commit SHA.
